fields.title: Stay a thin, composable layer over ADO.NET
fields.statement: Remain a simple layer over ADO.NET, never a walled garden. Keep setting parameters, invoking queries, and collecting results as independent steps a developer can use, skip, or override individually — and always leave an escape hatch to raw ADO.NET for anything the framework doesn't cover.
fields.rationale: No framework anticipates every requirement. Because ArgentSea stays close to ADO.NET and keeps each step separable, a developer can handle a unique case directly (as they would without the framework) while still reusing the parts that help — create parameters with the Mapper but issue the command by hand, or drop an unwanted parameter after mapping. A capability gap therefore never becomes a dead end.

metadata.provenanceNote: Derived from ArgentSea.DocFx during initial agentic onboarding, 2026-07-19. Draft for operator review.
